research.question:
Blocker 0: Current public contract evidence does not prove a provider-native Aras account identity. UserName/Password are credential fields and must not be used as canonical identity. Research official public Aras integration/onboarding material automatically; for internal_test, the implementation may use the existing CargoFlow local integration/account record as the non-secret account key.
Blocker 1: GetOrderWithIntegrationCode and GetBarcode exact SOAP request envelope details are not yet pinned in-tree. Resolve from the official public TEST WSDL/documentation through automated research; do not require an interactive WebFetch permission dialog.

official_sources.observation: Opened Aras Kargo’s corporate integration-services page on its corporate domain. It describes integration offerings and directs readers to sales/customer representatives for details; it does not specify a canonical API account identifier.

Opened Aras Kargo’s corporate customer-system page. It describes corporate customer accounts, directs customers to representatives for usernames/passwords, and links its customer portal at esasweb.araskargo.com.tr. Corporate branding, navigation, and the first-party portal link support publisher attribution beyond HTTPS alone.

claims.claim: The inspected official onboarding material does not establish a provider-native canonical account key.
claims.evidence: https://www.araskargo.com.tr/kurumsal-cozumlerimiz/entegrasyon-hizmetlerimiz lists integration models and refers readers to representatives. https://www.araskargo.com.tr/kurumsal-cozumlerimiz/musteri-islem-sistemi describes customer accounts and obtaining usernames/passwords, but supplies no immutable account-ID field, uniqueness scope, or identity-mapping contract. This conclusion is limited to the inspected pages.

claims.claim: Official public material supports treating username/password as access credentials, without establishing them as canonical identity.
claims.evidence: https://www.araskargo.com.tr/kurumsal-cozumlerimiz/musteri-islem-sistemi instructs customers to obtain their username and password from their sales/customer representative for access to MİS. This is portal onboarding evidence, not proof of SOAP account-identity semantics.

unresolved: No inspected official public source established a provider-native canonical account identifier.

The supplied internal_test fallback is a local implementation constraint, not an Aras-documented identity. Public research cannot verify the existing CargoFlow record, its non-secret key, or its implementation.

Opening https://customerservicestest.araskargo.com.tr/arascargoservice/arascargoservice.asmx?op=GetOrderWithIntegrationCode repeatedly failed with a timeout. Search excerpts were not accepted as contract evidence.

Opening https://customerservicestest.araskargo.com.tr/arascargoservice/arascargoservice.asmx?op=GetBarcode initially returned document metadata, but subsequent attempts to retrieve its supporting content failed with HTTP 502. Its exact envelope was therefore not verified.

The TEST WSDL at https://customerservicestest.araskargo.com.tr/arascargoservice/arascargoservice.asmx?WSDL could not be retrieved; the lowercase query variant also failed. Exact request namespaces, parameter casing/order/types, SOAP actions, and bindings remain unverified.
In-tree pinning was not inspected or performed because this task permits only read-only public web research.
research.summary: Official onboarding pages were accessed, but they do not prove canonical Aras account identity. TEST contract retrieval failures prevented verification of both exact SOAP envelopes. No credentials, service invocations, permission dialogs, or state changes were used.
